name: British Virgin Islands
flagName: Flag of the British Virgin Islands
summary: A British blue ensign with the islands' coat of arms: Saint Ursula in white holding a lamp, surrounded by eleven more lamps, with the motto 'Vigilate' (Be watchful).
origin: Christopher Columbus named the islands in 1493 after Saint Ursula and her 11,000 virgin martyrs. The coat of arms was granted on 15 November 1960.

symbols.name: Saint Ursula
symbols.description: A woman in white holding a lamp, on a green shield.
symbols.meaning: The saint after whom Columbus named the islands.

symbols.name: Twelve lamps
symbols.description: One held by Ursula and eleven around her.
symbols.meaning: Her companions, the virgin martyrs of legend.

facts: Columbus's legend counted 11,000 virgins; the shield shows a symbolic eleven lamps.
The neighbouring US Virgin Islands have a completely different flag.
clues: A blue ensign with a shield showing a woman in white holding a lamp, among eleven more lamps.
Its saint gave the islands their name.
